title: Databases with consistently heavy queries
description: For each database_name calculate sample_count, avg_duration_ms rounded to one decimal, max_duration_ms, and slow_count as queries with duration_ms at least 500. Keep only databases with sample_count at least 4, slow_count at least 2, and average duration_ms at least 200. Return exactly five columns: database_name, sample_count, avg_duration_ms, max_duration_ms, slow_count. Sort by slow_count DESC, avg_duration_ms DESC, database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name
FROM query_stats
GROUP BY database_name
hints: All three thresholds apply to aggregate values.
slow_count is produced with conditional aggregation.
solution_explanation: Multiple aggregates and HAVING conditions create a stricter heavy-load profile.
